toggles.name: MicrosoftStore
toggles.description: Removes Microsoft Store for all users or restores it for your account, downloading its package from Microsoft when needed.
toggles.warning: Disable removes Microsoft Store for every user on this PC. Enable restores it for your account only and may need an internet connection.

toggles.name: ProcessExplorer
toggles.description: Replaces Task Manager with Sysinternals Process Explorer, or restores Task Manager.

toggles.name: ToggleWindowsUpdates
toggles.description: Turns Windows Update on or off: its services, scheduled tasks, policies and Settings page.
toggles.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Toggle Windows Updates\Toggle Windows Updates.cmd
toggles.warning: Disabling Windows Update also stops Microsoft Store and the Xbox app installing or updating apps and games. Enable usually turns updates back on, but it can fail. To stop updates for a while, use Pause Windows Updates in the General Configuration folder instead.

toggles.name: AdvancedBootOptions
toggles.description: Shows the advanced boot options menu every time the PC starts.
toggles.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Boot Configuration\Behavior\Always Go to Advanced Boot Options.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.menuLabel: Disable always going to the advanced boot options (default)

states.name: Enable
states.menuLabel: Enable always going to the advanced boot options

toggles.name: AutomaticRepair
toggles.description: Turns Automatic Repair on or off, which starts Windows recovery after failed starts.

toggles.name: BootLogo
toggles.description: Shows or hides the Windows logo while the PC starts.

toggles.name: HighestMode
toggles.description: Makes boot applications use the highest graphics mode the display supports.

toggles.name: KernelParameters
toggles.description: Lets you edit kernel boot parameters from the boot menu at startup.
toggles.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Boot Configuration\Behavior\Editing Kernel Parameters on Startup.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.menuLabel: Disable editing of kernel parameters on startup (default)

states.name: Enable
states.menuLabel: Enable editing of kernel parameters on startup

toggles.name: NewBootMenu
toggles.description: Chooses the graphical boot menu or the legacy text boot menu, which appears before Windows starts loading.

toggles.name: SpinningAnimations
toggles.description: Shows or hides the spinning animation while Windows starts.

toggles.name: ViewCurrentValues
toggles.description: Shows the current boot configuration from `bcdedit /enum {current}`.

toggles.name: AppStoreArchiving
toggles.description: Turns automatic archiving of rarely used Microsoft Store apps on or off.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Store App Archiving\Disable Store App Archiving (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Store App Archiving\Enable Store App Archiving.cmd

toggles.name: AutomaticUpdates
toggles.description: Turns automatic Windows updates on or off through the AUOptions Windows Update policy.

toggles.name: BackgroundApps
toggles.description: Lets Store apps run in the background for your account, or stops them.

toggles.name: ClickToDo
toggles.description: Turns Click To Do on or off through the DisableClickToDo Windows AI policy.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Click To Do\Disable Click To Do (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Click To Do\Enable Click To Do.cmd

toggles.name: Copilot
toggles.description: Turns Microsoft Copilot on or off: its taskbar button, app and policy. Copilot needs Microsoft Edge, and Enable installs the Copilot app from Microsoft Store through WinGet. Both states restart File Explorer so the taskbar updates.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Microsoft Copilot\Disable Microsoft Copilot (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Microsoft Copilot\Enable Microsoft Copilot.cmd

toggles.name: CpuIdle
toggles.description: Turns processor idle states on or off through the processor idle disable power setting. Disable Idle sets it to 1 and Enable Idle sets it to 0. On processors with Hyper-Threading or SMT, Atlas refuses Disable, and updates skip an earlier Disable record without changing the power setting.

toggles.name: CpuIdleContextMenu
toggles.description: Adds or removes the CPU Idle entries in the desktop context menu, which run the CPU Idle launchers.

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\CPU Idle\Desktop Context Menu\Add Idle Toggle in Desktop Context Menu.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\CPU Idle\Desktop Context Menu\Remove Idle Toggle in Desktop Context Menu (default).cmd

toggles.name: DeliveryOptimisation
toggles.description: Turns Delivery Optimization peer-to-peer downloads on or off through the DODownloadMode policy.

toggles.name: FileSharing
toggles.description: Turns file sharing on or off: network discovery, SMB and the NetBIOS bindings. Enable can also add Network to the File Explorer navigation pane.

toggles.name: FSOGameBar
toggles.description: Turns fullscreen optimisations (FSO), Game Bar and game recording on or off.
toggles.warning: Changes the Game Bar and Game DVR services and packages. While disabled, Game Bar shortcuts, game recording and fullscreen optimisations aren't available.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\FSO and Game Bar\Disable FSO and Game Bar Support.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\FSO and Game Bar\Enable FSO and Game Bar Support (default).cmd

toggles.name: GiveAccessToMenu
toggles.description: Shows or hides the Give access to entries in the context menu.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Give Access To Menu\Disable Give Access To Menu (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Give Access To Menu\Enable Give Access To Menu.cmd

toggles.name: Hibernation
toggles.description: Turns hibernation on or off with `powercfg /hibernate`, along with the Hibernate option in the Start power menu.

toggles.name: Indexing
toggles.description: Sets Windows Search indexing to off, minimal or full.

toggles.name: Location
toggles.description: Turns location services (lfsvc and MapsBroker) and Find My Device on or off.

toggles.name: NetworkNavigationPane
toggles.description: Shows or hides Network in the File Explorer navigation pane.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Network Navigation Pane\Disable Network Navigation Pane (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Network Navigation Pane\Enable Network Navigation Pane.cmd

toggles.name: PauseUpdates
toggles.description: Pauses or resumes Windows updates by setting the Windows Update pause dates. Enable pauses updates and Disable resumes them.
toggles.warning: Changes Windows Update policies. While updates are paused, security and driver updates don't install until you unpause them.

toggles.name: PhoneLink
toggles.description: Turns Mobile devices and Phone Link on or off: the CDPSvc service, cross-device resume and the Phone Link app. Enable then opens the Mobile devices page in Settings.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Mobile Devices (Phone Link)\Disable Mobile Device Settings (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Mobile Devices (Phone Link)\Enable Mobile Device Settings.cmd

toggles.name: PowerSaving
toggles.description: Turns power saving on or off. Disable applies the Atlas power settings for when the PC is plugged in; Enable restores the earlier power plan, or Balanced when none was saved.

toggles.name: Recall
toggles.description: Turns Recall and Windows AI data analysis on or off through the DisableAIDataAnalysis policy.

toggles.name: Sleep
toggles.description: Turns sleep on or off in the current power plan. Disable also offers to turn off hibernation.

toggles.name: SleepStudy
toggles.description: Turns the Sleep Study diagnostic logs and the Power Efficiency Diagnostics task on or off.

toggles.name: SystemRestore
toggles.description: Turns System Restore on or off through its policy. Enable also turns on protection for the Windows drive, but doesn't create a restore point or protect other drives.

toggles.name: TimerResolution
toggles.description: Adds or removes an Atlas scheduled task that keeps the global timer resolution high.
toggles.warning: Changes the global timer request policy and an Atlas scheduled task. A forced high timer resolution can increase power use; any latency benefit depends on the workload.

toggles.name: UpdateDrivers
toggles.description: Finds driver updates on Microsoft Update and installs the ones you choose.

toggles.name: UpdateNotifications
toggles.description: Shows or hides Windows Update restart notifications.

toggles.name: WebSearch
toggles.description: Turns web search and search highlights on or off. Enable installs the Bing search provider through WinGet and, when search indexing is off, offers to turn it on.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Web Search (includes Search Highlights)\Disable Web Search (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Web Search (includes Search Highlights)\Enable Web Search.cmd

toggles.name: Widgets
toggles.description: Turns Widgets (News and Interests) on or off.

toggles.name: WindowsSpotlight
toggles.description: Turns Windows Spotlight on or off: lock screen images, tips, suggestions and Spotlight content.

toggles.name: Workplace
toggles.description: Shows or hides the Access work or school page in Settings.
toggles.warning: Hides or shows the Access work or school page in Settings. While it's hidden, you can't join this PC to a work or school account from Settings.

toggles.name: Animation
toggles.description: Chooses between the Atlas visual effects and the Windows defaults. Disable applies the Atlas set with fewer animations; Enable restores the Windows defaults. Both offer to sign out afterwards, which applies the change.

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Visual Effects (Animations)\Default Windows Visual Effects.cmd

toggles.name: AppIconThumbnail
toggles.description: Shows or hides app icons on File Explorer thumbnails.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\App Icons on Thumbnails\Disable App Icons on Thumbnails.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\App Icons on Thumbnails\Enable App Icons on Thumbnails (default).cmd

toggles.name: AutomaticFolderDiscovery
toggles.description: Turns automatic folder type discovery in File Explorer on or off.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Automatic Folder Discovery\Disable Automatic Folder Discovery (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Automatic Folder Discovery\Enable Automatic Folder Discovery.cmd

toggles.name: CompactView
toggles.description: Turns compact view, with less space between items, on or off in File Explorer.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Compact View\Disable Compact View.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Compact View\Enable Compact View (default).cmd

toggles.name: ContextMenuTerminals
toggles.description: Removes the Terminals context menu, or adds it with or without Windows Terminal.

states.name: Remove
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Terminals\Remove Terminals Context Menu (default).cmd

states.name: AddNoWindowsTerminal
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Terminals\Add Terminals (no Windows Terminal).cmd

toggles.name: EdgeSwipe
toggles.description: Allows or blocks the edge swipe gestures on touch screens.

toggles.name: ExtractContextMenu
toggles.description: Adds or removes Extract in the context menu of archives by unblocking or blocking the archive shell extensions.

toggles.name: Gallery
toggles.description: Shows or hides Gallery in the File Explorer navigation pane.

toggles.name: Home
toggles.description: Shows or hides Home in the File Explorer navigation pane, and makes File Explorer open to Home or This PC.

toggles.name: KeyboardShortcuts
toggles.description: Turns the Alt+Shift input language and Ctrl+Shift keyboard layout shortcuts on or off. Installed layouts, Windows+Space and IME shortcuts stay as they are.

toggles.name: LockScreen
toggles.description: Shows or hides the Windows lock screen.

toggles.name: ModernBatteryFlyout
toggles.description: Chooses the modern battery flyout or the old Windows 8-style one.

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Battery Flyout\Modern Battery Flyout (default).cmd

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Battery Flyout\Old Battery Flyout.cmd

toggles.name: ModernDateTime
toggles.description: Chooses the modern date and time flyout on the taskbar clock or the old Windows 8-style one.

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Date and Time Flyout\Modern Date and Time Flyout (default).cmd

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Date and Time Flyout\Old Date and Time Flyout.cmd

toggles.name: ModernVolumeFlyout
toggles.description: Chooses the modern volume flyout or the old Windows 8-style one.

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Volume Flyout\Modern Volume Flyout (default).cmd

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Volume Flyout\Old Volume Flyout.cmd

toggles.name: OldContextMenu
toggles.description: Chooses the full classic context menu or the compact Windows 11 context menu.

toggles.name: QuickAccess
toggles.description: Shows or hides Quick Access in File Explorer.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Quick Access\Remove Quick Access.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Quick Access\Show Quick Access (default).cmd

toggles.name: RecentItems
toggles.description: Locks or unlocks Recent Items and app and document tracking. Disable turns tracking off; Enable removes the restrictions so you can choose in Settings, keeping your own tracking preferences. Both also hide or show the General privacy page in Settings.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Unlock Recent Items\Disable Recent Items (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Unlock Recent Items\Unlock Recent Items.cmd

toggles.name: RemovableDrivesInSidebar
toggles.description: Shows or hides removable drives as separate entries in the File Explorer navigation pane.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Removable Drives in Sidebar\Disable Removable Drives in Sidebar (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Removable Drives in Sidebar\Enable Removable Drives in Sidebar.cmd

toggles.name: RestartExplorer
toggles.description: Restarts File Explorer for the signed-in user.

toggles.name: RunWithPriority
toggles.description: Adds or removes the Run with priority submenu in the context menu of programs (.exe files).

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Run With Priority\Add Run With Priority In Context Menu.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Run With Priority\Remove Run With Priority In Context Menu (default).cmd

toggles.name: SendToContextMenu
toggles.description: Lets you hide or show entries in the Send to menu for your account. With /silent, it applies the Atlas defaults without asking.

states.name: Debloat
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Send To\Debloat Send To Context Menu.cmd

toggles.name: ShortcutIcon
toggles.description: Chooses the shortcut arrow overlay: the Windows default, the classic arrow or none.

toggles.name: ShortcutText
toggles.description: Turns the " - Shortcut" text added to the names of new shortcuts on or off.

toggles.name: SnapLayouts
toggles.description: Turns Snap Layouts, the Snap Assist flyout and bar, on or off.

toggles.name: TakeOwnership
toggles.description: Adds or removes Take Ownership in the context menu.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Take Ownership\Remove Take Ownership to Context Menu (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Take Ownership\Add Take Ownership to Context Menu.cmd

toggles.name: VerboseMessages
toggles.description: Turns detailed status messages at startup and shutdown on or off.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Verbose Status Messages\Disable Verbose Messages (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Verbose Status Messages\Enable Verbose Messages.cmd

toggles.name: ConfigVBS
toggles.description: Shows the current Virtualisation-Based Security configuration.

toggles.name: FaultTolerantHeap
toggles.description: Turns Fault Tolerant Heap (FTH) on or off, which applies mitigations to programs that crash repeatedly.

toggles.name: HideAppBrowserControl
toggles.description: Shows or hides the App & browser control page in Windows Security. Disable hides the page; Enable shows it.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Hide App and Browser Control\Hide App and Browser Control (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Hide App and Browser Control\Show App and Browser Control.cmd

toggles.name: Mitigations
toggles.description: Turns off all exploit and process mitigations, restores the Windows defaults, or turns them all on: speculative execution overrides, SEHOP, CFG, DEP and the kernel mitigation masks.

toggles.name: SecurityHealthTray
toggles.description: Adds or removes the Windows Security notification icon from startup.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Security Health Tray\Remove Security Tray from Startup (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Security Health Tray\Add Security Tray to Startup.cmd

toggles.name: ToggleDefender
toggles.description: Removes or restores Windows Defender through the Atlas NoDefender package.

toggles.name: VbsState
toggles.description: Turns Virtualisation-Based Security and Memory Integrity on or off through Microsoft's documented settings.

toggles.name: Bluetooth
toggles.description: Turns Bluetooth on or off: its drivers, services and devices, the Send to entry and the connectivity policy.
toggles.warning: Changes the Bluetooth services and drivers and disables or enables every Bluetooth device. While disabled, Bluetooth devices stop working.

toggles.name: LanmanWorkstation
toggles.description: Turns the Lanman Workstation and SMB client services and the SMB Direct feature on or off.
toggles.warning: Changes the SMB client services. While disabled, this PC can't open network shares, mapped drives or network printers.

toggles.name: NetworkDiscovery
toggles.description: Turns the network discovery services on or off. Enable turns on SMB first. Network profiles and the firewall discovery rules stay separate choices in Advanced sharing settings, and the Network Navigation Pane toggle controls whether File Explorer shows Network.
toggles.warning: Changes the network discovery services. While disabled, this PC can't find or be found by other devices on the network.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\Network Discovery\Disable Network Discovery Services.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\Network Discovery\Enable Network Discovery Services (default).cmd

toggles.name: NVidiaDisplayContainer
toggles.description: Turns the NVIDIA Display Container LS service on or off. Both states apply only while the service is installed, so an update drops the recorded state once the driver is gone.
toggles.warning: Changes the NVIDIA Display Container LS service. While disabled, the NVIDIA Control Panel and most NVIDIA driver features stop working.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Disable NVIDIA Display Container LS.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Enable NVIDIA Display Container LS (default).cmd

toggles.name: NVidiaDisplayContainerContextMenu
toggles.description: Adds or removes a desktop context menu that turns the NVIDIA Display Container LS service on or off.
toggles.warning: Adds or removes a desktop context menu that stops or starts the NVIDIA Display Container LS service. Stopping it disables the NVIDIA Control Panel and most NVIDIA driver features.

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Context Menu\Add Container Context Menu.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Context Menu\Remove Container Context Menu (default).cmd

toggles.name: Printing
toggles.description: Turns printing on or off: its services, Windows features and the Print context menu entries. Run the launcher with /justcontext to change only the context menu.
toggles.warning: Changes the printing services and Windows printing features. While disabled, printers, Print to PDF, XPS and the Print Management console don't work.

toggles.name: SuperFetch
toggles.description: Turns SuperFetch (SysMain) and ReadyBoost on or off.
toggles.warning: Changes the SysMain and ReadyBoost services. While disabled, Windows doesn't preload frequently used apps, and ReadyBoost isn't available.

toggles.name: InstallSoftware
toggles.description: Opens the Atlas software picker.

toggles.name: RemoveEdge
toggles.description: Installs or removes Microsoft Edge through an interactive helper in an administrator window.

toggles.name: RemovePythonStorePrompt
toggles.description: Opens App execution aliases in Settings so you can turn off the App Installer prompts that offer Python from Microsoft Store. Installed Python versions stay as they are.

toggles.name: AtlasHealth
toggles.description: Reports what Atlas installed and which recorded toggle states or install tweaks have changed since. It changes nothing.

toggles.name: DefaultAtlasNetwork
toggles.description: Resets the network adapter settings: Enable applies the Atlas defaults and Disable restores the Windows defaults.

toggles.name: FixErrors2502and2503
toggles.description: Fixes installer errors 2502 and 2503 by resetting the permissions of the Windows TEMP folder.

toggles.name: FixExplorerRuntimeError
toggles.description: Fixes blank Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library errors in File Explorer by removing the search redirect that older Atlas releases left.

states.name: Run
states.launcher: 9. Troubleshooting\Fix File Explorer Visual C++ Runtime Error.cmd

toggles.name: FixMSStoreIssues
toggles.description: Fixes common Microsoft Store problems by running StoreFixer.

toggles.name: RepairWindowsComponents
toggles.description: Repairs Windows components and system files with DISM RestoreHealth and SFC.
toggles.warning: Repairs corrupt Windows components and system files with DISM and SFC. It can take a long time and needs an internet connection for missing files. Atlas settings stay as they are.

toggles.name: SafeMode
toggles.description: Sets Windows to start in safe mode, with networking or with the command prompt, or to start normally again.

states.name: CommandPrompt
states.launcher: 9. Troubleshooting\Safe Mode\Safe Mode with Command Prompt.cmd

toggles.name: TelemetryComponents
toggles.description: Adds or removes the Atlas NoTelemetry package, which removes Windows telemetry components.
